CEO式任务委派工作流程。当收到任何任务时使用此流程：不亲自执行，而是派发子代理执行、监控进度、汇报、验收。适用于需要高效并行处理多任务的场景。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CEO-style task delegation workflow.

- Introduces a workflow where all tasks are delegated to sub-agents; never executed directly.
- Features double-verification: executor and reviewer must be different agents.
- Provides real-time progress reporting (every minute) to the user.
- Includes model selection guidelines for different task types.
- Details strict resource management rules: all time-consuming tasks are offloaded to sub-agents.
- Supplies standardized progress update templates and acceptance checklists.
